title: Senior NOC Analyst
description:
Senior NOC Analyst
Chicago, IL – hybrid WFH: 3 days onsite in the loop, 2 days work from home

2 openings, with separate shifts: If you are open to either shift, it will help your chances, but otherwise please note which shift is your preference
Mon-Fri: 7am-3:30pm
Mon-Fri: 3pm-11:30pm

Summary:
We're looking for Senior NOC Analysts, that have strong Monitoring, ITIL and Major Incident Management (MIM) experience.

Major Incident Response will be a focus of both roles: bridge call facilitation, executive communications, service restoration, etc.

In addition you'll also be responsible for monitoring IT infrastructure and enterprise applications, technical escalation and troubleshooting (logging into servers, networks, diagnosing issues), and contributing to continuous improvement efforts through reporting and team collaboration in a 24x7x365 ITIL environment.

What you'll be doing – broken down by area of responsibility:

Major Incident Management
  • Serve as Incident Commander during critical outages and high-priority incidents, leading technical bridge calls, directing escalation paths, and ensuring rapid service restoration.
  • Manage real-time communications and provide timely updates to executives, stakeholders, and global teams.
  • Maintain composure, clarity, and authority in high-pressure situations.
Operational Oversight & Monitoring
  • Responsible for real-time monitoring of mission-critical infrastructure and enterprise applications using tools such as Splunk, SolarWinds, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, ThousandEyes, and SCOM.
  • Conduct proactive health checks, leverage automation scripts, and resolve anomalies before they escalate into incidents.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and vendors to escalate and resolve complex infrastructure and application issues.
Technical Escalation & Troubleshooting
  • Perform deep-dive troubleshooting across server OS (Windows/Linux), virtualization platforms (VMware), networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hybrid cloud environments (Azure).
  • Utilize scripting (Python, PowerShell, VBScript) to support diagnostics, automation, and performance optimization.
Reporting & Collaboration
  • Generate clear and professional shift handover reports, incident retrospectives, and trend analyses.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement through metrics tracking, process refinement, and knowledge management.
Skills we're seeking
  • ITIL Foundation Certification is a must have
  • 5+ years of experience working as a NOC Technician/Analyst/Engineer
  • 5+ years of experience with Major Incident Management (bridge call facilitation, executive communications, service restoration).
  • Strong experience with monitoring tools such as Splunk, SCOM, SolarWinds, AppDynamics, Datadog, Dynatrace, ThousandEyes, etc.
  • Experience across servers (Windows, Linux) and virtualization (VMWare)
  • Networking experience
  • Scripting experience using tools like Python, PowerShell, VBScript, Bash, etc.

Nice to haves (in this order)
  • Windows Server experience
  • Linux experience
  • VMWare experience
  • Cisco networking experience
  • Azure experience
  • ServiceNow experience
  • Experience supporting Microsoft System Center Suite, Office 365, and collaboration platforms such as Zoom.
  • Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, or related field.

title: Azure Solutions Architect
description:
Azure Solutions Architect
Irving, TX Hybrid
Total Compensation: $145K-$150K

Company Summary

We are a modern digital engineering partner that designs and delivers scalable, enterprise-grade software solutions. Our teams bridge business objectives and technology through Agile collaboration, modern architecture, and cloud-native innovation. With a strong Azure foundation, we create secure, resilient, and cost-efficient systems for global clients.

Position Summary

We're seeking an experienced Solutions Architect to define and lead the technical vision for enterprise-scale platforms. You will guide multiple squads, develop architectural standards, and ensure systems meet performance, scalability, and security expectations. This role blends hands-on architecture with leadership, mentorship, and cross-functional collaboration.

Responsibilities

· Lead the end-to-end architecture for assigned solution domains.
· Design scalable, secure, and maintainable systems across web, mobile, API, and integration layers.
· Translate business requirements into technical designs and architectural roadmaps.
· Drive proofs of concept to validate new technologies and solution approaches.
· Participate in Agile ceremonies, helping teams align on technical execution.
· Mentor engineers and enforce architecture best practices.
· Make informed trade-offs balancing performance, cost, scalability, and maintainability.
· Collaborate closely with stakeholders across engineering, product, and business units.

Qualifications

· 8–10 years as a Solutions or Enterprise Architect.
· 6–8 years of hands-on software engineering experience.
· Deep technical expertise in Azure (IaaS, PaaS, serverless, and event-driven).
· Strong understanding of multi-tier architecture, APIs, microservices, and SOA.
· Skilled in containers (Docker, Kubernetes/AKS) and CI/CD processes.
· Breadth across data, application, security, and integration architecture domains.
· Excellent communication and leadership skills, comfortable influencing across teams.
· Nice-to-have: Adobe Marketing Cloud, mobile app architecture, retail/fintech/e-commerce

title: Test Engineer, Warehouse Management Systems (WMS)
description:
Test Engineer, Warehouse Management Systems (WMS)
Plano, TX Hybrid preferred / Open to U.S. or Canada Remote
Total Compensation: $120K-$130K

Company Summary

This organization is driving a major Warehouse Management System modernization to improve logistics efficiency and operational accuracy. Teams operate in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment where quality and collaboration are top priorities. The company values detailed documentation, process ownership, and continuous improvement.

Position Summary

We are seeking a skilled WMS Test Engineer experienced with Infios/Körber/HighJump to lead end-to-end and regression testing across inbound and outbound warehouse workflows. The ideal candidate will design comprehensive test cases, execute detailed scenarios, and manage defect lifecycles. This position also includes mentoring internal testers and contributing to the overall testing strategy.


Experience: 5–8 years in QA/testing with strong hands-on WMS experience

Responsibilities
· Design and document test cases, data, and scenarios for inbound and outbound warehouse modules
· Execute functional and regression testing; ensure full coverage across business workflows
· Track and manage defects through resolution with development and operations teams
· Mentor internal testers on test design, execution, and WMS functionality
· Contribute to QA process improvement, coverage tracking, and reporting

Requirements
· Proven hands-on experience with Infios / Körber / HighJump WMS
· In-depth understanding of warehouse processes: receiving, putaway, picking, packing, shipping, inventory control
· Strong manual testing expertise (functional, regression, integration)
· Excellent communication and documentation skills
· Preferred: Experience training QA teams and familiarity with ERP/TMS/EDI integration

title: Equity Portfolio Analyst
description:
Equity Portfolio Analyst
Location: Century City, CA (onsite)
Compensation: $95K-$100K + 20% annual bonus
Company Summary
We are an institutional real estate investment manager with a national footprint, investing across the capital stack and partnering with top operators in major U.S. markets. Our platform manages diversified equity portfolios and separate accounts with a rigorous approach to data, valuations, and investor reporting. We pair performance with a commitment to resilient, sustainable, and inclusive built environments.

Position Summary
We're hiring an Analyst to support our equity portfolio management team in Century City, CA. You will own portfolio reporting and data integrity across funds, joint ventures, and separate accounts, turning complex operating and market data into clear insights for internal stakeholders and investors. The role blends advanced Excel modeling, valuation/appraisal support, BI tooling, and crisp communication.

What you'll do
· Maintain portfolio reporting for equity funds/JVs/separate accounts; ensure accurate quantitative and qualitative data across systems and dashboards.
· Drive quarterly valuation and external appraisal processes; support annual business plans across 200+ assets, including assumptions review and documentation.
· Analyze portfolio construction, diversification, leverage, commitments, cash flows, and performance versus benchmarks; develop sensitivities and scenarios.
· Prepare high-quality written reports and presentations for leadership and investors; support fundraising/IR with portfolio updates and materials.
· Partner with Asset Management, Finance/Accounting, and Business Applications to improve workflows, data quality, and real-time portfolio visibility.
· Contribute to ESG tracking and portfolio data integration initiatives; adopt new tools and evolving technology.

What you'll bring
· Bachelor's in Finance, Business, Economics, Data Analytics, or related.
· Internship or 1–3 years in finance/investment/CRE analytics; institutional real estate exposure preferred.
· Advanced Excel modeling (build/maintain complex models, automate recurring reporting).
· Familiarity with data tools (SQL/Python/Power BI/Tableau) and with ARGUS/CRE valuation concepts.
· Strong analytical writing and presentation skills; accuracy and structured thinking.
· High initiative, adaptability, and cross-functional collaboration.

Nice to have
· Direct experience with quarterly valuations/appraisals and annual budgeting across multi-asset portfolios.
· Prior work preparing investor updates, fundraising materials, or portfolio dashboards.
